messages:
annie_cs: @josh_se heads-up — ZenLabs just submitted a request for a multimodal reranker. They want text+image ranking for ecommerce search, high throughput, and PHI-free data but they mentioned product images and user-uploaded photos.

josh_se: thanks. main asks? latency SLOs / throughput / hosting?

annie_cs: quick list from customer: 1) 150ms p95 for top-k rerank (k=10) 2) ~200 qps steady, 2x burst 3) dedicated capacity preferred 4) offline eval harness with their testset 5) HSM for model keys if private deployment 6) guidance on quality vs quantization tradeoffs

lia_ml: sounds doable. couple clarifying q's: are images preprocessed client-side? do they expect embeddings-only (image+text fusion) or full encoder-decoder rerank? also need a sample of their eval labels.

annie_cs: @lia_ml they said client resizes to 512px, we can assume JPEG. Their host (elaine@zenlabs) will drop a 2k sample eval set into an S3 bucket we give. they prefer fusion (text + CLIP-style image emb) for reranker.

josh_se: from infra side, Dedicated sounds right — we'll propose a 4xA100 pool with autoscale and a warm KV cache. estimated cost note for cs: ~ $X/month (will update with exact). can hit 150ms p95 with batching tuned to 8-16 items and prefix cache for frequent queries.

tom_support: need to flag privacy: although they say PHI-free, user-uploaded images could contain sensitive content. recommend safety eval + content filtering pipeline before sending to model. also recommend consent wording in docs.

annie_cs: agreed. action items: (A) provide S3 path and upload instructions to Elaine (B) infra to give Dedicated config and cost estimate @josh_se (C) ML to draft eval harness + acceptance criteria @lia_ml (D) legal/safety checklist + filtering steps @tom_support. timeline: customer wants a pilot in 3 weeks.

josh_se: creating infra estimate now. rough config in case helpful: `dedicated_pool: {gpus: 4, instance: a100-80gb, min_replicas:2, max_replicas:8, batch_size_hint:12}`. fallback policy to hosted smaller model if capacity drops.

lia_ml: eval harness notes: we'll need their labeled pairs CSV and sample images zipped. acceptance: nDCG improvement >= 12% over their baseline, no toxic/image-policy failures >0.5% on sample. I'll build a scaffold and push a small runner. sample run command:```bash
python eval_runner.py --images s3://zenlabs-eval/sample.zip --pairs s3://zenlabs-eval/pairs.csv --model redwood/multi-rerank-v1 --out results.json
```

tom_support: I added checklist items to the ticket: image redaction options, malware scan for uploads, KMS integration for keys, and HSM requirement note.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-1423 — "ZenLabs multimodal reranker pilot" (assignees: annie_cs, josh_se, lia_ml)

annie_cs: copying Elaine with the S3 upload guide and expected timeline. Elaine said: "we can have the eval set ready by next Tue" — sounds tight but possible. I told them we'd prioritize evaluation infra. :rocket: 

josh_se: noted. I'll try to get a preliminary cost + infra sketch by EOD tomorrow. lia, if you can share the runner scaffold by Monday I can wire up capacity in staging.

lia_ml: on it — will post the repo link and sample metrics. also recommending quantization profile test (int8 vs nf4) — I'll include perf/quality matrix.

annie_cs: perfect. I'll follow up with renewal risk note: ZenLabs is on our growth plan; they said cost predictability is important before committing to Dedicated. we'll include a clear break-even timeline in the estimate.

tom_support: pinging legal for a quick review of the data access docs.

annie_cs: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. tagging follow-ups in CS-1423.
